div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: POST create or PATCH update on /api/audio, /api/video, /api/image, /api/text, /api/project or /api/category

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Audio, Video, Image and Text canonicalise inside applyDto and only when the DTO field is non-null; Project guards the same way on update but calls Tags.canonical and Keywords.canonical unconditionally in its create builder; Category has keywords and no tags

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Tags.TextListCanonicalizer.canonicalOne, looping over every entry in the list — NFKC normalize, zero-width non-joiner and joiner become a space, trim, then collapse every whitespace run to one space

div.style: color: rgb(74, 58, 18) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Null, empty after trimming, or longer than MAX_TAG_LENGTH 64 for a tag or MAX_KEYWORD_LENGTH 200 for a keyword

div.style: color: rgb(92, 32, 24) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: That entry returns null and is skipped silently — never truncated, because a truncated value would collide with an unrelated one; the rest of the list still persists

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Only now toLowerCase with Locale.ROOT — the cap is measured before folding — then a LinkedHashSet dedupes the survivors, first occurrence wins

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Canonical list replaces the element collection — audio_tags.tag, audio_keywords.keyword, the same pair on videos, images, texts and projects, plus category_keywords

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Service calls readCache.evictAll — @Caching drops the entity list region plus tags:suggest and keywords:suggest; CategoryReadCache has no tags, so it drops keywords:suggest only

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Caffeine regions tags:suggest and keywords:suggest — maximumSize 1000, expireAfterWrite 10 minutes, declared in CacheConfig

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: GET /api/tags/suggest or GET /api/keywords/suggest with required q and optional limit

div.style: color: rgb(74, 58, 18) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: canonicalOne of q is non-null and at least MIN_QUERY_LEN 1 character

div.style: color: rgb(92, 32, 24) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Return List.of — a blank or over-cap query matches nothing

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: A null or non-positive limit becomes DEFAULT_LIMIT 10, anything larger is clamped to MAX_LIMIT 25, then a self-injected ObjectProvider proxy calls lookup so @Cacheable actually fires

div.style: color: rgb(74, 58, 18) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Entry present for key Objects.hash of canonical and limit

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: TagSuggestRepository unions the 5 tag tables, KeywordSuggestRepository the 6 keyword tables — every leg joins its parent on removed_at IS NULL, groups by LOWER value, scores match_rank 0 exact, 1 prefix, 2 substring

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 41) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Ranked rows returned — match_rank asc, then usage_count desc, then value asc, cut off by the clamped limit

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: PATCH /api/admin/tags or /api/admin/keywords with body from and to, or DELETE with query param value — class-level @PreAuthorize hasRole ADMIN

div.style: color: rgb(74, 58, 18) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: canonicalOne of every supplied value is non-null — rename checks from before to

div.style: color: rgb(92, 32, 24) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 400 with code BAD_REQUEST — ResponseStatusException carrying the blank-or-over-the-cap reason, mapped by ApiExceptionHandler

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: VocabularyBulkRepository set-based SQL, no removed_at filter so trashed rows are rewritten too — rename runs UPDATE to the target WHERE LOWER value is the source, then a ctid self-join DELETE collapsing the duplicate a parent now holds twice, returning RenameCounts renamed and merged; delete runs a single DELETE WHERE LOWER value is the canonical value
